name: Freeport Indonesia

products: copper concentrate and cathode, gold, silver
parent_immediate: PT Mineral Industri Indonesia (MIND ID) 41.23% plus PT Indonesia Papua Metal & Mineral 10%; Freeport-McMoRan 48.77%
